Chapter 502 - 502 Small Gifts; Inhumane! (1)

Chapter 502 - 502 Small Gifts; Inhumane! (1)

502 Small Gifts; Inhumane! (1)

Lin Fan’s tone was calm and relaxed.

However, it made the ears of Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Hao Zhiwu buzz.

“Alright, then I’ll pack up this necklace and these two bracelets.”

Was he going to buy the Heart of the Milky Way which was priced at 182,000 euros and the Blue Enchantress that was priced at 390,000 euros?

The total was 962,000 euros, which was close to seven million yuan!

The blonde attendant was also slightly stunned.

t was too fast!

From the moment Lin Fan walked into the Cartier store until now, less than three minutes had passed.

In three minutes, he had only briefly introduced the products.

Did Lin Fan decide to buy them just like that?

The blonde attendant had served many big customers before, but he had never seen a customer make a decision so quickly.

After all, this involved nearly a million euros!

Wan Fei was the first to react. She sneered and said, “Liu Qianqian, your professor must be very interesting in class, right? He’s making jokes so casually.”

Obviously, she felt that Lin Fan had no intention of buying the Heart of the Milky Way and the Blue Enchantress.

He was just joking.

After all, the total value of these three pieces of jewelry was close to seven million yuan.

In just a few words, he wanted to buy jewelry worth seven million yuan, and it was for his own students?

How was this possible?

When Wan Fei opened her mouth to speak, she finally pulled everyone’s thoughts back to reality.

“Alright, I’ll wrap them up for you now!” The blonde attendant said excitedly.

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “No need to wrap them up. Just put the jewelry on them.”

Liu Qianqian quickly said, “Professor Lin, this is… too precious of a gift.”

Obviously, she did not care about Wan Fei’s joke.

Lin Fan said, “Everyone gets a gift. It’s just a little something.”

The blonde attendant quickly brought the Heart of the Milky Way to Liu Qianqian and put it on her neck.

“Beautiful lady, your skin and figure are very good. You match the Heart of the Milky Way very well! It’s perfect on you!”

He understood that as long as Liu Qianqian agreed, this transaction of nearly one million euros would belong to him!

Liu Qianqian wanted to reject him.

However, she looked at the Heart of the Milky Way on her neck, which looked like starlight, and could not speak for a moment.

The blonde attendant seized the time and put the Blue Enchantress on Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s wrists.

He praised again, “The bracelets have found their match!”

“I’ll pay by card,” Lin Fan said directly.

As he spoke, he handed over a bank card.

“Yes, Sir,” the blonde attendant said excitedly.

After a soft beep…

The bill appeared. The card was successfully swiped!

Nearly a million euros!

Nearly seven million yuan!

The transaction was successful!

Instantly, 680 red packets appeared on Lin Fan’s phone.

…

Only now did Wan Fei confirm that Lin Fan was not joking.

He really did buy Cartier jewelry and give it to his students!

…

Lin Fan looked at Xia Bing and Xia Xue and asked, “Do you like the bracelets?”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue nodded hard. “Yes!”

Even if Lin Fan gave them a piece of paper, they would still like it very much.

Moreover, they did think that the bracelets were very beautiful.

Lin Fan smiled. “It’s good that you like your gifts. Alright, you guys can continue shopping.”

After saying that, he walked out.

Liu Qianqian only retracted her gaze when Lin Fan completely disappeared from her sight.

She turned to Wan Fei and said, “Wan Fei, you were right. Our professor really bought us gifts.”

As she spoke, Liu Qianqian gently stroked the two-carat heart-shaped diamond on the Heart of the Milky Way.

Wan Fei said very unnaturally, “Yes… Yes.”

Previously, Wan Fei deliberately boasted about her necklace, bracelet, and bag. She just wanted to trample Liu Qianqian under her feet and make her look up to her.

In order to achieve her goal, she even said that Liu Qianqian’s teacher would prepare luxurious gifts for the bunch.

In the end, Liu Qianqian’s teacher had really prepared gifts!

Moreover, he had prepared luxurious gifts that cost more than a million yuan!

When Wan Fei raised her head, she happened to see the dazzling Heart of the Milky Way necklace on Liu Qianqian’s neck.

Then, she secretly hid her Cartier necklace, Chanel bracelet, and LV bag behind her.

After all, the ten items on her added together could not compare to one item of Liu Qianqian’s. It was too embarrassing!

“F*ck! My watch is actually a Vacheron Constantin Traditionelle. It costs 1.5 million yuan in Hua Nation!” Hao Zhiwu shouted.

Then, he said, “I’ll help you check too!”

Hao Zhiwu shouted again.

“Jiang Chaoqun, your watch is a Vacheron Constantin 5370P. The domestic price is 1.58 million yuan!

“Nie Zhenjiang, your watch is a Vacheron Constantin Lange 760. The domestic price is 1.81 million yuan!”

A series of screams shocked everyone.

Originally, Jiang Chaoqun and Zhenjiang were just holding their watches casually with one hand.

At this moment, they could not help but hug the watches tightly in their arms.

Wan Fei, who was standing at the side, wished she could find a hole to hide in.

She had just said that these few watches should be worth dozens or hundreds of dollars.

In the end, they were each worth more than one million!

Wan Fei felt as if her entire face had been slapped a few times.

It hurt!

It hurt!

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

He continued to shop at Chanel, Prada, Hermes, and other stores for a while. He bought some gifts for Hu Tian, Qin Yuxuan, Han Tian, Chu Yunyue, and the others. After spending about 50 million yuan, he returned to the Shangri-La Hotel.
